OreGrade.description:
MOIL sells ore by grade, and PRD §3 is explicit that a shortfall in one
grade is not fungible with a surplus in another. Forecasting is therefore
grade-aware (PRD B-5 [PS] P0, B-9 [D] P1).
OreGrade.title: OreGrade

description:
The planned target a shortfall is measured against (PRD B-6:
"Compute shortfall risk against the planned target").

contract_version.description: Schema version this row was written under.
contract_version.title: Contract Version

is_synthetic.description: True for generator output, False for data supplied by MOIL. Required — there is no default, so a producer must state it.
is_synthetic.title: Is Synthetic

source.description: Where the row came from, e.g. 'nakshatra-synthetic-v1' or 'MOIL CMMS export 2026-03'.
source.title: Source

grade.description: Null means the target is across all grades.
